# stb

`stb_image.h` (v2.30) and `stb_image_write.h` (v1.16) from
[nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb), unchanged: the files as of their last
commits, `013ac3b` (2024-05-31) and `1ee679c` (2021-07-12). Public domain or MIT
(`LICENSE`). `native/ngfx_core.c` compiles them for `load_texture` (PNG and BMP) and
`save_png`.
